items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Quentin Jackson (PHONETIC) was the vocalist in the band.

ctx.x: Well, had a first trumpet player by the

name of Langston Curl, Joe Smith was playing a second trumpet, playing all the ballads. Another guy by the name of Buddy Lee (PHONETIC) was playing the high notes. Quentin Jackson (PHONETIC) was the vocalist in the band. Another boy by the name of Coffee (PHONETIC) was playing lead trombone in the band and Cuba Austin Cue Boston (PHONETIC) was the drummer. They had a (inaudible) saxophone player. It was a guy by the name of Prince (PHONETIC), that worked for -- he was a tenor saxophone player. He played for years…
Oh, Dave Wilburn (PHONETIC) was the banjo player. (Todd-ed.) Rhodes Another fellow by the name of Rolls (PHONETIC) was playing piano and they were all good musicians out of the Detroit area.
